issue.title: Agroal - Only generate health checks for JDBC datasources

body: Thanks for the report. https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/38959 should fix it.
Thanks for looking into the issue. Just want to check if the fix will be backported to 3.7.x or 3.8?
Yes it's planned for being backported to 3.8.

Hey, thanks for fixing this!
Is the fix planned to be backported to 2.16.12.Final?
or is there a recommended workaround to make it work with the lesser versions?

2.16 is not supported anymore so there won't be fixes there. But the issue explicitly states that the problem started occurring with Quarkus 3.7+ so I'm not even sure you would be affected by this specific issue (might be another one).

I would recommend to move to 3.8 as you won't get any security fixes in 2.16.

You can use `quarkus update` to do most of the grunt work of updating to 3.8.
